|game_text=Deploys only to battlegrounds. Power +3 when defending a battle. You may not deploy [Episode I] Jedi. While with a [[Wookiee (V){{!}}Wookiee]], adds one battle destiny. Once per game, may lose 2 Force from Force Pile to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. Immune to attrition.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-yodagreatwarrior-pre.gif]], slip number 56E). It was made by 9 December 2009 (the same image is in the V-kit of that date) and may be older; it is placed at that date because no firmer date is known. The current text is [[Yoda, Great Warrior (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013.
* '''Original''' ([[Yoda, Great Warrior]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009).<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 6, slip 56E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref> Full text: “Deploys only to battlegrounds. Power +3 while defending a battle. You may not deploy [Episode I] Jedi. While with a Wookiee, adds one battle destiny. Once per game, may lose 2 Force from Force Pile to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. Immune to attrition.” Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-56E-Yoda_Great_Warrior.png]]) prints slip number “56E” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-yodagreatwarrior-pre.gif]], slip number 56E, errata mark E) prints: “Deploys only to battlegrounds. Power +3 when defending a battle. You may not deploy [Episode I] Jedi. While with a Wookiee, adds one battle destiny. Once per game, may lose 2 Force from Force Pile to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. Immune to attrition.” The same image is in Lee Edwards' V-kit, committed on 9 December 2009<ref name="vkit-2009">Lee Edwards' V-kit, [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit-legacy/tree/81e004826e5697f45d10c4330f78ff8136dae46f/public/images/vslips swccgvkit-legacy <code>public/images/vslips</code>] (commit 81e0048, migrated from svn on 28 May 2010; the <code>.svn/entries</code> files record svn r1 committed 2009-12-09T05:41:52Z for these slips). The file <code>virtual14-light/yodagreatwarrior.png</code> is the same image as the Players Committee card image (same words, slip number and errata mark), compared by eye on 11 November 2026.</ref>, so it was made by then. No firmer date is known (the card list carries no errata stamp for this wording), so it is placed at that proven upper bound, “by 9 December 2009” (versions ruling of 11 November 2026, 08:23); the image may be older. '''What changed:''' compared with the original, “Power +3 while defending” becomes “Power +3 when defending”. The PC website's image folder carries the same file with the server date 25 February 2013, a later bulk upload of the unchanged image. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 5 set mark) and prints the number “56E” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does; its caption bottom left reads “•Yoda’s Hope (V)”, the label of another card.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Yoda, Great Warrior (Errata 2)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) changed “+3 while defending” to “+3 when defending”, changed “deploy Jedi.” to “deploy [Episode I] Jedi.” and changed “non- S” to “non-[Immune to Sense]”.<ref name="cl-1250_55-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> Full text: “Deploys only to battlegrounds. Power +3 when defending a battle. You may not deploy [Episode I] Jedi. While with a Wookiee, adds one battle destiny. Once per game, may lose 2 Force from Force Pile to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. Immune to attrition.” The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it. Compared with PC-E1 (the PC card image), the words are the same (the card list writes the icons out).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Yoda, Great Warrior (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side p. 16), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=16, page 16. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=16 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploys only to battlegrounds. Power +3 while defending a battle. You may not deploy [Episode I] Jedi. While with a Wookiee, adds one battle destiny. Once per game, may lose 2 Force from Force Pile to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. Immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC card image (PC-E1) and the PC website card list (PC-E2) had published different wordings. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-55-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it prints the errata mark “E” bottom right; it shows the whole card top (title bar and lore) with the slip pasted over the lower part; the label under the slip reads “•Yoda’s Hope (V)”, the label of another card.
